progress.command:
git "commit" "-m" "build(deps): upgrade pi to 1.6.0 and pit to v0.39.2, and fit every tool's images

- @earendil-works/pi-durable, pi-ai, and chord 1.6.0. pi's system prompt and the
  read, write, edit, and bash text did not change: PI_PROMPT_VERSION is 1.6.0
- One image processor per run, also without pi-durable extensions: read gets it
  (createCodingTools({ images })), and pi-durable 1.6.0's fit-images extension,
  installed first, fits the images of every other tool's results.
  Extensions cannot take the name fit-images
- Replace the deprecated @octokit/webhooks-types with
  @octokit/openapi-webhooks-types; the trigger author is checked with toUserType
- oxfmt 0.80.0, oxlint 1.95.0, oxlint-tsgolint 7.0.2008, knip 6.48.0 (drop the
  entries that knip now finds itself), and transitive updates
- pit v0.39.2 in pi-assistant.yml and the docs

Refs #93"
